910.name: Pre-Columbian Honduras
910.description: Early human habitation, Lenca and Pech peoples, cave art, and the early development of the Copán Valley.

sub_clusters.name: Early Inhabitants and Lenca Peoples
sub_clusters.description: Archaic through Formative settlement, Lenca, Pech, and Tawahka peoples in the central and eastern highlands.

sub_clusters.name: Copán — Pre-Classic Foundations
sub_clusters.description: Early occupation of the Copán Valley, Olmec-influenced jade, pre-dynastic settlement.

920.name: Classic Maya Copán
920.description: Copán — the Maya 'Athens of the New World': elaborate stelae, Hieroglyphic Stairway, astronomy, sculpture.

sub_clusters.name: Copán Dynastic History
sub_clusters.description: K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' founds dynasty (426), sixteen kings, Altar Q, Temple 16 Rosalila.

sub_clusters.name: Hieroglyphic Stairway
sub_clusters.description: Longest Maya hieroglyphic text (2,200+ glyphs), political history on monumental staircase.

sub_clusters.name: Copán Collapse
sub_clusters.description: 18 Rabbit's capture by Quiriguá (738), environmental degradation, population decline, abandonment.

920.name: Lenca and Indigenous Kingdoms
920.description: Post-Classic Lenca chiefdoms, Miskito peoples of the Mosquito Coast, multi-ethnic landscape before conquest.

sub_clusters.name: Lenca Chiefdoms
sub_clusters.description: Fortified hilltop centres, decentralised governance, Lempira's later resistance becomes national legend.

sub_clusters.name: Miskito Coast Peoples
sub_clusters.description: Miskito, Pech, Tawahka, Garifuna — eastern lowland peoples, maritime adaptation, later British alliance.

930.name: Spanish Conquest and Colonial Honduras
930.description: Columbus's landfall, Lempira's resistance, silver mining at Comayagua, colonial backwater status.

sub_clusters.name: Columbus's Fourth Voyage Landfall
sub_clusters.description: Columbus reaches Trujillo Bay, names 'Honduras' (depths) for deep waters, first mainland contact.

sub_clusters.name: Lempira's Resistance
sub_clusters.description: Lenca leader Lempira unites Indigenous warriors against Spanish at Cerquín, killed by treachery, national hero.

sub_clusters.name: Colonial Mining and Economy
sub_clusters.description: Silver mining near Comayagua, labour drafts, cattle ranching, marginal colony within Captaincy General.

940.name: Independence and Political Instability
940.description: Independence from Spain, Central American federation, Morazán's liberal cause, chronic political turmoil.

sub_clusters.name: Independence and Federation
sub_clusters.description: Independence (1821), Mexican annexation, Federal Republic, Francisco Morazán — Central American liberator.

sub_clusters.name: Morazán's Liberal Legacy
sub_clusters.description: Honduran-born Morazán leads federation, reforms, exile and execution in Costa Rica, national hero.

sub_clusters.name: Caudillo Era
sub_clusters.description: Political instability, dozens of coups, conservative-liberal oscillation, weak state institutions.

950.name: Banana Republic Era
950.description: The quintessential 'banana republic': United Fruit and Standard Fruit dominance, labour struggles, military politics.

sub_clusters.name: Liberal Reform and Banana Concessions
sub_clusters.description: Marco Aurelio Soto's reforms, railroad and banana concessions to US companies, export monoculture.

sub_clusters.name: United Fruit and Standard Fruit
sub_clusters.description: Company towns, private railroads, Tela Railroad Company, political manipulation, 'banana republic' coined.

sub_clusters.name: Great Banana Strike of 1954
sub_clusters.description: 69-day strike by 25,000 workers, birth of organised labour movement, partial victory, lasting legacy.

950.name: Military Rule and Cold War
950.description: Military coups, Football War with El Salvador, US Cold War base, Contra staging ground.

sub_clusters.name: Football War (1969)
sub_clusters.description: 100-hour war with El Salvador over immigration and land tensions, 2,000+ dead, regional fallout.

sub_clusters.name: US Military Presence and Contra Base
sub_clusters.description: Honduras as US staging ground for Nicaraguan Contras, Palmerola airbase, Battalion 316 disappearances.

sub_clusters.name: Return to Civilian Rule
sub_clusters.description: 1981 elections, civilian government, but military retains significant power behind democratic façade.

960.name: Post-Cold War Honduras
960.description: Hurricane Mitch devastation, democratic consolidation, gang violence, maquila economy.

sub_clusters.name: Hurricane Mitch (1998)
sub_clusters.description: Category 5 storm kills 7,000+, destroys 70% infrastructure, sets development back 20 years.

sub_clusters.name: Maquila and Remittance Economy
sub_clusters.description: Export-processing zones, textile maquilas, diaspora remittances become economic lifeline.

sub_clusters.name: Rise of Gang Violence
sub_clusters.description: MS-13 and 18th Street expansion, deportee returnees, world's highest homicide rate, mano dura policies.

960.name: Contemporary Honduras
960.description: Zelaya coup (2009), narco-politics, JOH presidency, Xiomara Castro, migration caravans.

sub_clusters.name: Zelaya Coup d'État (2009)
sub_clusters.description: Manuel Zelaya ousted by military, constitutional crisis, international condemnation, democratic erosion.

sub_clusters.name: JOH and Narco-State Allegations
sub_clusters.description: Juan Orlando Hernández's presidency, drug trafficking ties, 2022 extradition to US, narco-state charges.

sub_clusters.name: Migration Caravans
sub_clusters.description: Mass migration caravans to the US, root causes: violence, poverty, corruption, climate change.

sub_clusters.name: Xiomara Castro Presidency
sub_clusters.description: First woman president, Zelaya's wife, leftist agenda, anti-corruption pledges, gang crackdown.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
